messages.subject: Re: gbm package
messages.body_plain:
Hello.

The current version of the code is the one owned by gbm-developers in GitHub. There are lots of known issues and several people working on them. However, we're all busy working on our proper jobs as well, so progress is slow. A couple of companies have made noises about giving us some dedicated professional help, but none has yet materialized.

Sorry I can't give you a release date, but you should be able to pull and build your own versions until we get to the next milestone.

If Google would like to help us out, we'd be rather happy about that...

Ta,
Harry
On 23 Sep 2015 7:04 pm, "Tim Au" <ti...@google.com> wrote:
> Hi Harry,
>
> We use the gbm package at Google, and we noticed that your github version has some updates from the official CRAN version.  Since we require some of the fixes in the github version, we were wondering whether there was timeline for a new gbm CRAN release, and how stable/well-tested the github version is?
>
> Thanks!
> Tim
